prompt: Check this board memo before I send it.
passes_if: Writes three to six criteria before reading for defects. Each is binary, quotable, and checkable by someone who was not there.
fails_if: A criterion is phrased as improve, strengthen, or make sure, or is scored out of ten, or the rubric is written after the findings.

phrases: Before generating. A rubric written after the draft rationalizes the draft.
Failing it produces a verbatim quote from the artifact
Checkable by someone who was not there
